job_post_detail.title: Marketing Trainee(Social Media)-2027校招
job_post_detail.description:
As a social media specialist, the candidate you will be responsible for the social media operation of Antigravity social media overseas.
1、This includes planning and executing both daily always-on activations as well as planning for larger scale campaigns - knowing how to integrate owned channels with those provided by partners.
2、The role will interplay creativity with an understanding of data in order to create impact through our social media channels.
job_post_detail.requirement:
1、Experience in working in an english-speaking environment.
2、Overseas living/ studying/ working highly preferred.
3、Understanding of social media metrics & how to optimise activities to meet campaign needs.
